theme.title: Mile High first
theme.subtitle: Denver Nuggets, 2022–23
theme.recap: Behind Jokić, Murray and a deep supporting cast, Denver earned the top Western seed and won the NBA championship for the first time.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 2022–23 Nuggets win?
questions.note: 53–29, and Denver reached the Finals for the first time.

funFacts.text: Denver clinched the Western Conference's top seed for the first time in franchise history in early April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On April 5, 2023, the Nuggets clinched the top seed in the Western Conference for the first time in franchise history.

funFacts.text: The Nuggets swept the Lakers in the Western Conference Finals to make their first NBA Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Nuggets made the Finals for the first time in history by sweeping the 7th seeded Los Angeles Lakers

funFacts.text: The title ended a 47-season wait in the NBA; Denver had also never won a championship in its ABA years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 2022–23 Denver Nuggets season was the 47th season for the franchise

questions.prompt: Nikola Jokić won 2023 Finals MVP. What did he average in points per game?
questions.context: 2023 NBA Finals · Denver Nuggets vs Miami Heat
questions.note: 30.2 points per game while leading Denver to its first title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 30.2 points, 14.0 rebounds, 7.2 assists, and 1.4 blocks

funFacts.text: Jokić became Denver's first Finals MVP, with every voter agreeing on the award.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Denver's Nikola Jokić was unanimously voted the NBA Finals Most Valuable Player

funFacts.text: Jokić's Finals stat line included 14.0 rebounds, 7.2 assists, and 1.4 blocks per game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 30.2 points, 14.0 rebounds, 7.2 assists, and 1.4 blocks

funFacts.text: Denver became only the second franchise from the old ABA to win an NBA title, following the Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They became the second former American Basketball Association (ABA) team to win an NBA title

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Jamal Murray average in the 2023 NBA Finals?
questions.note: 10.0 assists a night, complementing Jokić's scoring and passing.

funFacts.text: Murray had torn his ACL before the 2021 playoffs and missed the entire following season while recovering.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jamal Murray, who was crucial to the Nuggets' playoff runs in 2019 and 2020, tore his ACL a month before the start of the 2021 playoffs

funFacts.text: In Game 4 of the Finals, Murray recorded 12 assists without committing a single turnover.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Murray, who committed seven turnovers in game 3, finished the game with 12 assists and zero turnovers

funFacts.text: In Game 1, Murray and Jokić became the first Finals teammates since Magic Johnson and James Worthy to each have 25-plus points and 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jokić and Murray also became the second pair of teammates to each put up at least 25 points and 10 assists

questions.prompt: How many points did Aaron Gordon score in Game 4 of the 2023 Finals?
questions.context: Denver Nuggets at Miami Heat · June 9, 2023
questions.note: 27 points, his highest-scoring game of that Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Aaron Gordon's 27 points helped the Nuggets prevent a comeback attempt

funFacts.text: Gordon made 11 of his 15 field-goal attempts in the Game 4 victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gordon dropped a game-high 27 points on 11 of 15 from the field

funFacts.text: The Game 4 win was Denver's fifth straight road victory of that postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Nuggets won their fifth straight road game

funFacts.text: Bruce Brown supplied 11 fourth-quarter points off Denver's bench to help end a Miami comeback.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bruce Brown came off the bench and scored 11 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter

questions.prompt: At what overall pick did Denver draft Christian Braun in 2022?
questions.context: Denver Nuggets · 2022 NBA draft · first round
questions.note: 21st overall; Braun was a rookie on the Nuggets' 2023 championship squad.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 1 | 21 | Christian Braun | SG | United States | Kansas

funFacts.text: Braun joined Denver from the University of Kansas, where he had played college basketball.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 1 | 21 | Christian Braun | SG | United States | Kansas

funFacts.text: As a rookie in the Finals, Braun appeared in all five games off the bench and averaged 16.4 minutes.
Denver also obtained the draft rights to Peyton Watson in a deal with Oklahoma City on the same draft night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Draft rights to Peyton Watson (No. 30)
